column1: # Cutoff sweep with --fixed=1 --cached=0 (always default strategy, never
# pull from per-worker cache on restart). Combined with default --pol=0
# this means: every non-skip restart re-rolls a fresh per-bit random
# assignment. The only restarts that "skip" are descent-in-progress
# ones (best strictly improved since previous restart), which is by
# design and not gated by any option.
# Sweep purpose: with deterministic "fresh random per cutoff" mode
# enabled, what's the best cutoff?  Previous sweep (configs-cutoff-nocache)
# had the random-strategy escape hatch active.
